cause: The modern PDF.js worker calls Math.sumPrecise while building OpenType font tables. Chrome 145 lacks this API, so the embedded FandolSong and other fonts fail conversion and PDF.js renders substitute fonts.
fix: Use the unmodified legacy/build/pdf.min.mjs and legacy/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs from the same official package, preserving resource URLs and supporting CMaps, standard fonts and WASM.

regression.method: Run the real reading page and bundled worker, forcibly removing Math.sumPrecise before worker initialization. Assert no font warnings and successful loading of embedded PDF fonts.
regression.before: Failed with TypeError: Math.sumPrecise is not a function
regression.after: Passed with embedded serif font loaded
